summary: Captures a clean stack trace at registration time and splices it onto any assertion error's own stack, so a failed .expect() in test output points at the calling test code instead of disappearing into supertest's internals. Itself has a real, multi-year fix history: Node-version-dependent stack formats, and an error-object check that had to be added after a real reported bug (#700).
